flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The biggest move came in [[Michigan]], where Polymarket odds show a sizable drop in the chances of the Democrat Abdul El-Sayed. In [[Maine]], the Democrat Troy Jackson gained ground in a race the market lists as a predicted flip. In [[Iowa]], the Republican Ashley Hinson also moved up modestly.
summaries.governor: In [[Georgia]], the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms gained a moderate amount of ground in the Polymarket odds, and the market shows it as a predicted flip. In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds saw a moderate dip in their chances. The Republican Ty Masterson in [[Kansas]] also edged up slightly, another race the market lists as a predicted flip.
summaries.house: In [[NY-17 (Spring Valley & Ossining)]], the Democrat Cait Conley gained ground by a moderate amount, and the market calls it a predicted flip. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the chances of the Republican Brad Knott slipped moderately. The Republican Anna Paulina Luna in [[FL-13 (Clearwater & Largo)]] also moved up by a moderate margin.
